Chat request with seed parameter for deterministic output; response includes system_fingerprint

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Pick a random number\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"seed\":42}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)
    print(result.system_fingerprint)

asyncio.run(main())
```
